## Summary

The business-day roll for the owner registration date already handled weekends but not public holidays. I extended `toBusinessDay` in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- Added a `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` set with the five fixed dates: `2026-01-01`, `2026-01-26`, `2026-04-25`, `2026-12-25`, `2026-12-28`.
- Rewrote the roll-forward logic as a loop that advances one day at a time while the date is a Saturday, Sunday, **or** a listed public holiday, so it lands on the next non-holiday business day.

This correctly handles chained cases too — e.g. Friday `2026-12-25` (holiday) rolls over the weekend to Monday `2026-12-28` (also a holiday) and finally to Tuesday `2026-12-29`. The implementation mirrors the reference algorithm the acceptance test uses, and `./mvnw test` reports `BUILD SUCCESS` with no failures.
